Name: Em's Farm Horses (barn animal)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Add horses to the barn to gather coal and throw their shoes
Melt their shoes into metal bars to use for your farm
Available for Content Patcher and compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]Additional options available with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]extra animal configs﻿[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HW3fRtSG/Horse-Shoe.png[/img]

Farm horses need plenty of grass and pets to stay happy
They can be pretty impatient when waiting for their food in the morning, but lucky for you, it pulls up [color=#e69138]coal[/color] from the dirt
Their clumsiness does make them throw their [color=#e69138]horseshoes[/color] regularly
These horseshoes can either be made from [color=#e69138]copper[/color], [color=#e69138]iron[/color] or [color=#e69138]gold[/color]
Reuse them by melting them into bars for other projects!

The furnace uses 1 horseshoe and 1 coal for a metal bar
The heavy furnace takes 3 shoes and 3 coals for 3 bars in half the time

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Farm Horses"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

You can change the sound of the horses to either a gentle snort, a nicker or a neigh
Open the config.json file in the horse mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Snort[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]Nicker[/color]" or "[color=#e69138]Neigh[/color]"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CLbFQxPd/EAC.png[/img]

You can choose to add a few additional features with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]extra animal configs﻿
[/url]This is optional and not a requirement!

Changes that come with e.a.c. are:
Quality of coal and horseshoes are removed to keep a tidy barn
Horses come outside in winter to enjoy the cold snow
